extracted.intended_audience: patent examiners, patent searchers, and researchers (esp. software-related patent community)
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance and resources for conducting prior art searches to identify the most relevant prior art for patent examination, with materials and references including software-related examination guidance. Includes links to MPEP chapters, FAQs, and search strategy resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Software Partnership initiative: investigation and sharing of search strategies
rubrics_metrics.description: One initiative of the Software Partnership is the investigation and sharing of search strategies, and the improvement of tools and resources to evolve better techniques to identify prior art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Purpose: improve techniques and tools to identify prior art; encourages community sharing of best practices to aid USPTO in locating relevant search resources and determining best prior art for examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: Involvement of the scientific community in sharing best practices
rubrics_metrics.description: Involvement of the scientific community in sharing best practices should help the USPTO identify the most relevant search resources and determine the best prior art for examination.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Implied criterion: engage domain experts and researchers to surface non-obvious or domain-specific sources of prior art and search methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Federal Register Notice: Prior Art Resources for Use in the Examination of Software-Related Patent Applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Federal Register Notice: Prior Art Resources for Use in the Examination of Software-Related Patent Applications, 79 Fed.Reg. 644 [2013-31492] (06Jan2014).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Official notice enumerating resources specific to software-related patent examination; consult for policy-level guidance and referenced resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: How to Conduct A Preliminary U.S. Patent Search: A Step by Step Strategy (video)
rubrics_metrics.description: How to Conduct A Preliminary U.S.Patent Search: A Step by Step Strategy (VIDEO).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A step-by-step strategy resource for performing preliminary patent searches — recommended for searchers and applicants to learn systematic search methods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent Search Resources Available Through the USPTO Web Site
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent Search Resources Available Through the USPTO Web Site.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Collection of USPTO-hosted search tools and documentation; use these official tools as primary starting points for searching patent literature.

rubrics_metrics.name: Patent and Trademark Resource Centers Materials and Services
rubrics_metrics.description: Patent and Trademark Resource Centers Materials and Services.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Local libraries and centers that provide materials, training, and assistance for patent searching — useful for hands-on help and access to resources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art Electronic Resources Available to Patent Examiners
rubrics_metrics.description: Prior Art Electronic Resources Available to Patent Examiners.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Lists electronic databases and subscriptions examiners may use; implies criterion to leverage specialized electronic resources in searches.

rubrics_metrics.name: Prior Art FAQ
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Frequently asked questions addressing common prior art search and submission issues — consult for clarifications and procedural points.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scientific and Technical Information Center (STIC)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A USPTO resource for technical information and literature; use STIC for locating scientific/technical documents relevant as prior art.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP Chapter 901: Prior Art
rubrics_metrics.description: Selections from the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP): MPEP Chapter 901: Prior Art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contains MPEP policy and guidance concerning what constitutes prior art and its treatment in examination; consult for formal standards and definitions.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP Chapter 904: How to Search
rubrics_metrics.description: Selections from the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP): MPEP Chapter 904: How to Search.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural guidance on search strategies and examiner search practices; use for methodologic standards on how searches should be conducted.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP Chapter 704: Search and Requirements for Information
rubrics_metrics.description: Selections from the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP): MPEP Chapter 704: Search and Requirements for Information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on the examiner's search responsibilities and what information must be developed or required during examination.

rubrics_metrics.name: MPEP Chapter 706.02: Rejection on Prior Art
rubrics_metrics.description: Selections from the Manual of Patent Examining Procedure (MPEP): MPEP Chapter 706.02: Rejection on Prior Art.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Guidance on issuing rejections based on prior art and the legal/analysis standards examiners should apply when making prior-art-based rejections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: Contact: Seema Rao, Director, Technology Center 2100 (571)272-0800.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provides a point of contact for questions about prior art search resources and initiatives.
